While he is angry, the specific nature of the insults targets his self-worth and professional identity, making Pride the dominant emotion. Next time, I will analyze the specific content of the insults (ego, talent, career) to identify that the character's defensive aggression is a direct manifestation of bruised Pride, and I will assign the highest score (10) to Pride, with Resentment as a secondary, lower score (e.g., 4), and zero for Fear and Apathy.
